meta.title: Files | Invessiv
meta.description: Everything we shared with you and everything you sent us, in one place.

page.heading: Files
page.intro: Find drafts and documents from us here. Upload logos, photos, copy or videos for your project right on this page.

intake.dropLabel: Choose files or drop them here
intake.dropHint: Photos, videos up to 200 MB, logos, fonts and documents · up to 20 files at once
intake.linkHint: File too big or already in the cloud? Just send us the link.

upload.title: Upload files
upload.description: We see your files as soon as they are uploaded.
upload.dropHint: Up to 20 files, 1 GB in total
upload.largerHint: Larger files? Add a link instead.
upload.notePlaceholder: Optional, e.g. “White logo for dark backgrounds”
upload.busyHint: Keep this window open until every file is uploaded.

link.title: Add link
link.description: For large videos or folders in Google Drive, Dropbox and the like. We only open the link when we need the files.
link.name: Label
link.urlHint: WeTransfer links expire after 7 days. Upload the file instead or use a permanent link.
link.urlInvalid: Enter a complete link starting with https://.

list.label: Files and links
list.loadError: The files could not be loaded.

fromUs.title: Nothing from us yet
fromUs.description: As soon as we share drafts, exports or documents with you, they are ready here to view and download.

fromYou.title: You haven't sent us anything yet
fromYou.description: Upload logos, photos, copy or videos – everything we need for your project. We see it right away.
fromYou.readOnlyDescription: Everything your team uploads or sends as a link appears here.

archive.videoHint: Download videos one at a time.

lightbox.error: The preview could not be loaded. Download the file instead.

owner.hint: You can't upload in the portal view.

errors.FILE_NOT_FOUND: This file is no longer available. Reload the page.
errors.FILE_VALIDATION_ERROR: Some details are missing or invalid.
errors.FILE_ARCHIVE_LIMIT: Select at most 100 entries with 300 MB in total.
errors.FILE_ARCHIVE_VIDEO: Download videos one at a time.
errors.FILE_PENDING_LIMIT: Too many uploads are running. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.FILE_UPLOAD_OWNER: Only the person who started this upload can finish it.
errors.FILE_NOT_UPLOAD: This entry is a link, not a file.
errors.FILE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: File storage is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_EXTENSION: We can't accept this format. A PDF, image or link works.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large for this format. Send us a link instead.
errors.BATCH_TOO_LARGE: At most 1 GB per upload in total.
errors.MISSING_OBJECT: The file did not arrive completely. Try again.
errors.SIZE_MISMATCH: The file did not arrive completely. Try again.
errors.CONTENT_TYPE_MISMATCH: The file type does not match its extension.
errors.INVALID_SIGNATURE: The content does not match the file extension.
errors.UNSAFE_SVG: The SVG contains scripts or external references. Please send it as a PNG or PDF.
errors.INVALID_OFFICE: The Office document is damaged or contains macros. Save it without macros or as a PDF.

errors.UPLOAD_REFUSED: File storage refused the upload. Try again.
